gloss: uniqueness; singularity; the quality of being one of a kind

definitions.gloss: uniqueness; singularity; the quality of being the only one of its kind
definitions.explanation: The abstract quality of being unique — the property that nothing else is equivalent or a substitute. Used in philosophy, business, mathematics, database design, and identity-related discussions to describe the one-of-a-kind nature of a thing or value.

examples.japanese: {唯一性|ゆいいつせい}がある。
この{作品|さくひん}の{唯一性|ゆいいつせい}が{価値|かち}を{生|う}んでいる。
examples.english: The uniqueness of this work is what gives it its value.

examples.japanese: データベースではIDの{唯一性|ゆいいつせい}を{保証|ほしょう}する{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: In a database, you need to guarantee the uniqueness of IDs.

examples.japanese: NFTはデジタルデータに{唯一性|ゆいいつせい}を{持|も}たせる{仕組|しく}みとして{注目|ちゅうもく}された。
examples.english: NFTs drew attention as a mechanism for giving digital data a quality of uniqueness.

notes:
Composed of {唯一|ゆいいつ} (only one, sole) and the abstract-noun-forming suffix {〜性|せい} (-ness, -ity).

USAGE:
{唯一性|ゆいいつせい} is an abstract, somewhat formal word. It is typical in writing — academic papers, legal and business documents, technical specifications, philosophical discussions — rather than casual conversation. In information-technology contexts it is often a translation of the English term "uniqueness" (as in unique key or unique identifier).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {唯一性|ゆいいつせい}を{持|も}つ: to have / possess uniqueness
- {唯一性|ゆいいつせい}を{保証|ほしょう}する: to guarantee uniqueness
- {唯一性|ゆいいつせい}がある: to be unique
- {唯一性|ゆいいつせい}を{証明|しょうめい}する: to prove uniqueness (mathematical sense)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {独自性|どくじせい}: originality, distinctiveness — emphasizes being one's own and different, not merely the only instance
- {一意性|いちいせい}: uniqueness (mathematics, computing) — near-synonym, especially common in data modeling
- {特殊性|とくしゅせい}: peculiarity, special nature — the quality of being special or particular, not necessarily one-of-a-kind
- {独創性|どくそうせい}: originality, creativity — uniqueness of idea or creation
